title: LuaSyncPayload
description: Python→Lua IPC file at LUA_SYNC_DIR/bans.json (default /run/crowdsec-lua/bans.json). Written atomically by push_lua_state() via mkstemp+fsync+os.replace. OpenResty polls this file every 5s and loads verdicts into a shared dict. Lua validates entry_count and payload_crc32 before accepting; on mismatch it keeps the previous good state.

version.description: Monotonically increasing sync counter within the current daemon process. Resets to 1 on daemon restart. Lua uses this to detect frozen pushes (auto-heal trigger).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC offset, written by datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().

updated_at_epoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) at push time. Convenience field for Lua/shell consumers that cannot parse ISO dates.

entry_count.description: len(bans) + len(cidrs). Lua verifies this matches the actual counts before accepting the payload.

writer_pid.description: PID of the Python daemon process that wrote this file.

bans.description: Per-IP ban verdicts. Keys are IPv4 or IPv6 address strings.

cidrs.description: Per-CIDR ban verdicts. Keys are CIDR strings (e.g. '1.2.3.0/24').

meta.description: Python daemon operational counters. Lua exposes these at /crowdsec-status and /crowdsec-metrics without a separate port-8765 call.

degraded.description: True when daemon is in degraded mode (CF unreachable at boot or degraded_reason set).

payload_crc32.description: CRC-32 (unsigned, masked with 0xFFFFFFFF) of the canonical JSON of the payload before this field was added (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)). Used by Lua as a lightweight integrity check.

score.description: Threat score. CrowdSec bans: 70 base + 10 per recidivist count (capped at 100). ModSec: 80. CIDR: 100.

ttl.description: TTL in seconds. CrowdSec bans: 3600. ModSec bans: MODSEC_BAN_SECS (default 7200). CIDR: 86400.
